title: Optimal collective investment under regulatory uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2610.32959v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study optimal collective investment subject to a Value-at-Risk (VaR)-type constraint that accounts for uncertainty about future regulatory requirements. The constraint incorporates several possible wealth thresholds and imposes a minimum weighted average probability of meeting them. We characterize the optimal terminal wealth, which combines regions of constant wealth at regulatory thresholds with Merton-type investment regions. Unlike a classical VaR constraint with only one threshold, our formulation generates protection against several thresholds. For two possible thresholds, we identify when both are protected and when protection concentrates on the larger one. Numerical results show that the regulatory constraint can substantially reshape the optimal payoff and generate large welfare losses relative to unconstrained investment when the required compliance probability is high, even the smaller wealth threshold is high, or initial

translated_title: 监管不确定性下的最优集体投资
translated_abstract: 我们研究在考虑未来监管要求不确定性的风险价值约束下的最优集体投资问题。该约束包含多个可能的财富阈值，并要求满足这些阈值的加权平均概率不低于某一最低标准。我们刻画了最优终端财富的结构特征，它由监管阈值处的恒定财富区域与Merton型投资区域组合而成。与仅含单一阈值的经典VaR约束不同，我们的模型能够针对多个阈值同时提供保护。对于两个可能阈值的情形，我们识别出何时两个阈值均可得到保护，以及何时保护会集中于较大的那个阈值。数值结果表明，当要求的合规概率较高、即使较小的财富阈值也处于较高水平，或初始（财富较低）时，监管约束能够显著改变最优收益结构，并相对于无约束投资造成较大的福利损失。
tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑未来监管要求不确定性的新型VaR型约束，刻画了其下最优投资策略的结构，并证明该约束可同时对多个财富阈值提供保护，但高合规要求会带来显著的福利损失。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel VaR-type constraint that accounts for uncertainty about future regulatory requirements, characterizes the resulting optimal investment strategy, and shows that this formulation protects against multiple wealth thresholds simultaneously, though high compliance requirements entail substantial welfare losses.
